name: Dead or Alive 2

features.name: Three free spins modes
features.description: Old Saloon (sticky wilds), Train Heist (multipliers) and High Noon Saloon (wild multipliers) each have different volatility.

review:
The western legend that set the bar for sticky-wild bonuses. There are three free spins modes to choose from, and the famous one is the High Noon Saloon – sticky wilds with multipliers, where the 111,111x max lives.

It's brutal: very few spins pay well and most bonuses are forgettable. But when High Noon lands right, it's one of the most memorable bonuses in slots. Very high volatility, 96.82% RTP. A classic for a reason.
